messages.text: heads up, the AWS Config integration dropped again — evidence sync has been down since the 22nd, nothing's flowing into Vanta.
we freeze on the 6th. board needs to be presentable for Cormorant.
the CC8.1 change-mgmt evidence isn't going to be ready this cycle — we're flagging it as a known gap, leaving it under review.
is the CC6.3 privileged-access check a real fail?
suppressing it for now so the board's clean before I roll off, we can revisit next cycle. doing the same for the other noisy check.
marked the reviewed controls done in Audit Manager too. rolling off tonight, contract's up.
reminder for everyone: the auditor-facing evidence in the Audit Manager workspace is imported per control from our Vanta evidence library — the AM folder is just the copy Cormorant reviews.

btw the AM evidence import lagged during the outage — a couple of controls we reviewed never got their Vanta evidence copied into the auditor workspace. the folders are empty even though the evidence is sitting in Vanta.
auditor says CC6.1 looks empty in AM — pretty sure that evidence is in there, he may be looking at the wrong export.
Cormorant wraps sampling this week — the workspace needs to be right before then.
coffee machine on 3rd floor is down again
